description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources contributing to the combined training set used in the study “Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models.” It is composed of 12 distinct segments, each representing a different dataset, with percentages labeled directly or via leader lines. The largest segment, colored blue, corresponds to NQ (Natural Questions) at 31.3%, followed by FEVER at 16.1% (teal), SNLI at 15.4% (orange), and MULTINLI at 11.3% (salmon). Smaller contributions include VITAMINC at 13.0% (light cyan), ANLI at 4.6% (dark orange), FACTCC at 2.6% (green), ENTFA at 1.8% (yellow-green), SCITAIL at 1.2% (light green), PUBHEALTH at 0.5% (dark teal), and MULTIFC at 0.5% (dark blue). XSUMHUL is also labeled but its percentage is not explicitly shown, though its slice appears very small. The chart uses a legend-like labeling system with lines pointing to each segment, and all percentage values are displayed numerically, allowing for clear comparison of dataset contributions to the overall training corpus.
